summary: F1 witnessed: ModernAppTest runs the step's secrets script under sh -xe with a recording fake kubectl, and it failed on the old -e - pipe. Real kubectl 1.35.9 also cut `ab#cd…` to `ab` and split a value at a line break. The script (now @NonCPS secretsScript) passes each secret as a kubectl `NAME=value` argument, so `#`, line breaks and trailing newlines arrive whole and stay out of the trace. JenkinsPipelineUtils 521fac6; kc project test green; done-record updated.
